hero.tagline: Some places you visit. Others, you feel, by reconnecting with yourself, others, and the world around you.

wildlife.title: Where to meet the wild
wildlife.description: Encounter the extraordinary biodiversity of the Togean Islands. From playful dolphins to ancient turtles, vibrant reef fish to rare endemic birds – discover wildlife both above and below the water.

accommodation.title: At rest: Island Guest Houses
accommodation.subtitle: Curated stays: Explore All
accommodation.contentDescription: Unhurried stays, island-simple comfort, and warm hosts. You explore by day, then unwind on land in thoughtfully chosen guest houses.

malenge.title: Malenge
malenge.description: A tropical paradise of dense jungles and unspoiled beaches, home to the fascinating Bajo sea gypsy culture.

kadidiri.title: Kadidiri
kadidiri.description: The travel hub of the Togeans, featuring powdery white beaches, vibrant house reefs, and a friendly atmosphere.

unaUna.title: Una Una
unaUna.description: Volcanic-island atmosphere, cool evenings, and a peaceful place to reset.

luwuk.title: Luwuk
luwuk.description: The scenic mainland gateway to the Togeans, offering dramatic coastal views and modern conveniences.

guestHouse.title: By the sea at sunrise, under stars at night
guestHouse.description: Wake to soft sea light, fall asleep to waves. Open-air evenings, clear skies, and the slow island rhythm that resets your body clock.

comfort.title: Crafted with locally sourced woods
comfort.description: Built with local timber and island know-how. Natural textures, sturdy joinery, and a warm, grounded feel that fits the landscape.

sharedSpaces.title: Sleep easy & quiet comfort
sharedSpaces.description: Clean beds, good airflow, and low-noise nights. Simple comforts that help you rest deeply and wake ready for tomorrow's boat time.

hosts.title: Stay on preserved beaches, intentionally chosen
hosts.description: We choose beaches that stay quiet and cared for. Minimal footprint, fewer crowds, and settings that keep nature feeling untouched.

meals.title: Designed with care for thoughtful stays
meals.description: Small details done right: shade, seating, storage, and lighting. Spaces that feel considerate, practical, and easy to live in.

impact.title: Evenings made calm and intimate
impact.description: Sunset tea, soft lamps, and quiet conversation. A gentle end to the day, where you can read, reflect, or simply listen to the sea.

localCommunity.title: Meet the locals
localCommunity.description: Connect with the warm-hearted communities of the Togean Islands. Experience authentic village life, traditional crafts, and centuries-old customs passed down through generations.

cta.title: Start your journey now — talk with our travel designer
cta.description: Share your dates and pace. We'll shape a calm, island-led itinerary built around you.

boat.heroDescription: Discover the details that make every journey smooth, safe, and memorable. From our captain's expertise to the quiet comfort of the deck.

localCommunityPage.heroDescription: Experience the heart of Togean and Luwuk through the people who call it home. Discover a culture built on warmth, shared stories, and the timeless rhythm of coastal life.

howToBooking.pageDescription: We believe in direct connection. All bookings are confirmed personally via WhatsApp or email to ensure your itinerary is perfectly tailored to your needs.
howToBooking.whatsappDescription: The fastest way to secure your spot. We usually reply within an hour during business days. Send us a quick message to check availability.
howToBooking.emailDescription: Prefer a detailed itinerary in your inbox? Send us your requirements and we will craft a custom proposal for you.
howToBooking.paymentDescription: To secure your booking, we typically require a deposit with the remaining balance due closer to your trip date. We accept Bank Transfer and Debit Cards.
howToBooking.paymentNote: Exact payment details and deadlines will be shared in your booking confirmation.
howToBooking.faq1Answer: We aim to reply to all inquiries within 24 hours. For WhatsApp messages during business hours, you can expect a response within an hour.
howToBooking.faq2Answer: Yes, we are flexible. Date changes are subject to availability. Please let us know as soon as possible if you need to reschedule.
howToBooking.faq3Answer: Absolutely. Whether vegetarian, vegan, or allergies, we ensure your meals are safe and delicious. Just mention it when you book.
howToBooking.faq4Answer: We offer both options. Most of our itineraries are private for a personalized experience, but we can also arrange shared trips on request.
